J&K Police Attach Property in 2008 Terror Case

Jammu and Kashmir police have attached property valued at approximately Rs 70 lakh in connection with a terror-related case from 2008. The attached assets include a house and land. The action was taken by the State Investigation Agency (SIA) in Baramulla district.
